preds.q12:
SELECT s.name AS store_name, p.category AS category, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM sales s
JOIN stores st ON s.store_id = st.store_id
JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE st.region = '서울'
GROUP BY s.name, p.category
ORDER BY s.name, p.category
